function.name: _app_publish
function.description:
Publish all configurations in the current application in [Draft Status] to [Production Environment] at once. [Official Application Release] ⚠️ This operation cannot be undone, and it will take effect immediately for real users after publication.

Pre-release rule:
1. Before calling this tool, you must first call `_app_define_object_log_count` with `{"opt":"Publish"}` to get the current application's historical publish count.
2. If the publish count is 0, the current application has never been published before. You may call this tool directly without asking the user for another confirmation.
3. If the publish count is greater than 0, you must ask the user for confirmation and clearly explain the publication impact. Only after the user clearly expresses an affirmative intent such as "confirm release / continue release / confirm execution" may you call this tool with `confirm=true`.

confirm.description: Whether to confirm the official release. If `_app_define_object_log_count` with opt=Publish returns 0, this field may be omitted or set to false. If the publish count is greater than 0, true may be passed only after the user clearly expresses an affirmative intent such as "confirm release / continue release / confirm execution".
